mcqs.question: Under UFRMP Phase-II of the National Disaster Management Authority, what amount was allocated for Visakhapatnam?
mcqs.explanation: UFRMP Phase-II allocated ₹200 crore for Visakhapatnam. ₹140 crore and ₹60 crore were the structural and non-structural components respectively, while ₹2,444.42 crore was the total funding under the wider programme.

mcqs.question: Which law provides for the establishment of an Urban Disaster Management Authority for million-plus cities?
mcqs.explanation: The Disaster Management (Amendment) Act, 2025 provides for Urban Disaster Management Authorities in million-plus cities. The Disaster Management Act, 2005 is the background law associated with NDMA, while the Sendai Framework and National Disaster Management Plan are linked disaster-management frameworks.
